summary.scope: Fixed20 diagnostic subset of the existing videophy60 shared-first-image protocol

cases.caption: Two swimmers race side-by-side, their hands entering the water simultaneously, creating small trails of bubbles.
A player throws a sidearm pass; the football travels on a sideways trajectory before being caught.
A spinnaker is deployed on a racing yacht, expanding like a parachute and creating a large amount of thrust.
Multiple paragliders launch sequentially from a cliff edge, showcasing the staggered takeoffs and individual flight paths.
A sailor uses a winch to tighten the halyard raising a heavy mainsail high up the mast.
A construction worker uses a socket wrench to turn a large bolt on a metal beam, the wrench exerting significant force.
A small piece of wood is broken along the grain creating a small splintered tear.
A flat piece of Styrofoam rests on a ramp of plywood, its flat base creating friction.
A crane's claw gently nudges a large container, causing it to shift a few centimeters.
A sledgehammer is swung at a pile of rocks, scattering and breaking some of them.
A billiard ball is struck and rolls across a felt-covered pool table, hitting another ball.
A soccer ball is kicked and hits a person's leg, deflecting at a different angle.
An object shaped like a globe is poked, causing it to spin on its axis, revealing different countries.
An athlete throws a hammer, the rotation of the hammer head clearly visible against the sky.
A bubble gum bubble is blown and then punctured using a finger.
Arrows are shot at a moving target, with some arrows hitting and some missing visibly.
A player kicks a soccer ball which hits a lamp post, the ball rebounding at an angle.
Nunchucks are swung, striking a punching bag, creating a visible ripple effect.
Two javelin throwers launch their javelins simultaneously, showing the trajectory of each.
A potter applies a thin layer of slip to a clay bowl, using a brush to create an even coat.
